boots: TPU 95, glued beneath Knee Pitch V2; knee-servo housing, Knee Pitch V2, and boot form each rigid lower-foot assembly
known_limitations: Knee-servo housing, Knee Pitch V2, and its glued boot are rigid lower-foot parts; the hip-pitch bracket is attached to the rotating knee-servo output circle.
Each TPU-95 boot is a measured 5 g lumped mass at its mesh-center approximation.
Foot contact uses 3 mm TPU-95 spherical sole proxies with provisional softness and friction.
Mesh geometry is visual-only; no printed-part self-collision.
